FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Paws & Claws Pet Shoppe operates as a retail space for pet supplies and grooming services, primarily catering to domestic animals such as dogs, cats, and small mammals. Our store offers a broad range of high-quality pet food, toys, accessories, and grooming products. In addition to retail, we provide professional grooming services to ensure the health and well-being of pets, which includes bathing, fur trimming, nail clipping, and ear cleaning. Our grooming staff has undergone thorough training in animal handling and safety protocols to create a safe environment for both pets and clients. We prioritize health and safety by maintaining clean, well-ventilated facilities with non-slip flooring and secure enclosures to promote a positive experience. We strive to make pet care a positive experience for our customers while ensuring that all operations comply with regulatory standards.
